verified_environment.python_dependencies: Exact versions in requirements-dev.txt; checked against the installed environment. A fresh network installation was not performed.

automated_tests.frontend_method: The actual inline index.html script executes in a simulated DOM with controlled network responses and timers; no third-party JavaScript dependencies.
frontend_coverage: Cached-stock labels and physical-count guards for unavailable, paused, delayed, inconsistent, or unconfirmed updates
Sync timestamp aging even when the HTTP endpoint remains reachable or requests hang
Out-of-order successes and failures for both polling services
Stable retry request IDs, concurrent order submission, and kitchen independence during an inventory outage
Recipe draft preservation and version conflicts
Expiry labels rolling over with the inventory snapshot date
Request timeout handling and text-only rendering of supplied labels

browser_walkthrough.method: Manual observations from the initial prototype walkthrough; these are not automated test cases.
browser_walkthrough.data: Clearly labelled fictional deliveries, recipes, orders and measurements

browser_followup_review.method: Manual browser check after the freshness changes

scope.services: Independent order/kitchen and inventory HTTP services with separate SQLite databases
scope.kitchen_batch_allocations: Assumed earliest recorded expiry eligible on the preparation business date
